purpose: Convert heterogeneous company/environment evidence into a source-traceable environmental-management study dossier. The dossier is for a non-expert user who needs to understand what the company manages, why selected evidence matters, and what still requires verification. It must not make unsupported causal, legal-compliance, risk, or performance judgments.

notes.company_name: Natural-language company name supplied by the user.
notes.analysis_period: Requested multi-year window. Source-native disclosure cadence is preserved; missing annual values are never fabricated.
notes.requested_scope: Optional business-unit/site scope such as Samsung Electronics DS. Raw evidence remains preserved outside the scoped review view.

selection_protocol.principle: Never decide the representative pollutant or metric before inventorying the source-native evidence. The protocol, not a fixed company-specific list, determines what is promoted into the main review.

output_bundle.page_policy: No fixed page target. Use enough pages to explain the management structure and evidence without repeating raw tables. Detail that does not change what the user should inspect next stays in the workbook/archive.

brief_generation_policy.architecture_first: Explain company/process/site/environmental-management architecture before detailed site or pollutant trends.
brief_generation_policy.media_inventory_before_selection: For each environmental medium, disclose what metrics/sources exist before explaining why some were selected for detailed review.
brief_generation_policy.site_repetition_policy: Do not repeat every metric for every site. Site-specific detail appears when it explains a material process/site difference, a multi-year signal, or a management action.
brief_generation_policy.management_timeline: Use the full available multi-year action/investment window. Do not default to the latest year only.
brief_generation_policy.selection_transparency: The evidence workbook must distinguish no-data, context-only, overview, main-review and deep-dive-candidate states.

brief_sections.title: Company Environmental Management Architecture
brief_sections.goal: Show how business/process/site structure creates environmental-management interfaces and how common management functions such as permits, EMS, monitoring, investment and emergency response sit across media.

brief_sections.title: Site & Source Coverage
brief_sections.goal: Make clear which sites, years and source-native metrics are available and which are absent or short-series.

brief_sections.title: Multi-year Management Action & Investment Timeline
brief_sections.goal: Show disclosed facilities, investments, reuse/reduction projects and management actions across the whole available period, separated by site and environmental domain.

brief_sections.title: Environmental Media Review
brief_sections.goal: For each environmental medium: show what is managed, what data exists, which signals passed the selection gates, related management evidence, limitations and what to inspect next.

brief_sections.title: Site-specific Exceptions
brief_sections.goal: Show site detail only when process role, expansion, source coverage or evidence patterns materially differ from the company-wide view. Equal page allocation by site is not required.

brief_sections.title: Priority Review Topics
brief_sections.goal: Promote only evidence-backed topic candidates. Topic candidates must expose evidence dimensions and limitations; human adoption remains required.
brief_sections.rule: Do not force a fixed number when evidence is weak. Prefer non-redundant topics that answer different environmental-management questions.

brief_sections.title: Process / BAT / Regulatory Context
brief_sections.goal: Explain why an observed fact may matter technically without guessing company-specific process or BAT application.

brief_sections.title: Questions for Further Review
brief_sections.goal: Turn unresolved evidence into concrete questions about process use, equipment, operating conditions, production scale, legal requirements, inlet/load, treatment performance or definition changes.

brief_sections.title: Evidence Index
brief_sections.goal: Allow every material fact and AI review statement to be traced back to source, site/scope, year and evidence location.

AI_REVIEW.definition: AI-proposed relationship, prioritization or study suggestion built from one or more facts.
AI_REVIEW.human_role: User evaluates whether the evidence is understandable and useful, then adopts, holds or rejects the review suggestion.

TO_VERIFY.definition: Information required before a stronger interpretation can be made.

hard_boundaries: No automatic statement that investment caused an emission change.
No automatic rating that environmental management improved or worsened from absolute emissions alone.
No legal-compliance claim without the applicable site/facility-specific requirement.
No treatment-efficiency claim without inlet/load and relevant operating information.
No claim that a company applies a BAT unless company-specific public evidence supports it.
No forced comparison across incompatible definitions, scopes, units or regulatory measurement transitions.
No chemical risk ranking from PRTR quantity alone.
Keep raw/source evidence available even when the main dossier omits it.
